title: Suddenly…
goal: Tell a short story with a scene, events and earlier events, linked by o sırada, birden, aniden and çoktan.

intro.text: A story needs a scene in `-(I)yordu`, events in `-DI` and earlier events in `-mIştI`. Small words link them: *o sırada* (at that moment), *birden* and *aniden* (suddenly), *çoktan* (long since).

exercises.en: I was walking in the street. Suddenly it started to rain.
exercises.explain: *Birden* (suddenly) brings in an event that breaks the scene; the event is in `-DI`: *başladı*.

accept: All of a sudden we heard a [sound|noise|voice].

exercises.question: Why couldn't Can open the door?

context.tr: Can gece eve dönüyordu. Hava çok soğuktu.
context.en: Can was coming home at night. It was very cold.
He got to the door, but he couldn't find his key.
He had left his key at the office that morning.

options: He had left his key at the office
exercises.explain: *Unutmuştu*: he **had forgotten** it, in the morning, before the moment of the story.

exercises.prompt: The child was running, and he fell.

reject.why: *Koştu* makes the running a separate event, **he ran and fell**. He fell while running: *koşuyordu*.

exercises.en: We arrived, but the bus had long since left.

reject.why: *Henüz* + a positive verb is **just**: the bus had only just left. **Long since** is *çoktan*.

exercises.tr: O sırada ben mutfakta çay yapıyordum.
exercises.en: At that moment I was making tea in the kitchen.

exercises.title: Garip bir gece
exercises.passage:
Geçen kış bir gece eve dönüyordum. Hava çok soğuktu ve kar yağıyordu. Sokakta kimse yoktu. Birden arkamda bir ses duydum. Döndüm ve baktım: küçük bir köpek! Köpek arkamdan geliyordu.

Apartmanın kapısına geldim ve anahtarımı aradım, ama anahtar yoktu: sabah evde unutmuştum. O sırada komşum Elif pencereden bakıyordu. Hemen indi ve kapıyı açtı. Köpek de bizimle içeri girdi. Elif köpeği çok sevdi. O kış köpek hep onun evinde kaldı.

glossary.en: to follow me, to come along behind me

exercises.translation: Last winter I was coming home one night. It was very cold and it was snowing. There was nobody in the street. Suddenly I heard a sound behind me. I turned and looked: a little dog! The dog was following me. I got to the door of the building and looked for my key, but it wasn't there: I had left it at home that morning. At that moment my neighbour Elif was looking out of the window. She came down at once and opened the door. The dog came in with us too. Elif loved the dog. That winter the dog stayed at her place the whole time.

questions.q: Why couldn't the narrator get in?
options: The dog was in the way
questions.explain: *Sabah evde unutmuştum*: the pluperfect puts the forgetting earlier, that morning.

questions.q: What was Elif doing at that moment?
options: She was looking out of the window
questions.explain: *Pencereden bakıyordu*: `-(I)yordu` for what was going on at that moment, after *o sırada*.

questions.q: Where did the dog stay that winter?

reject.why: Without `-(y)DI` it's the present: **it's a strange night**. Add *-ydi*: *geceydi*.

exercises.prompt: O gece korkunç bir olay oldu.
exercises.text: A terrible thing happened that night.
accept: A terrible event happened that night.
That night a terrible thing happened.
That night a terrible event happened.

exercises.text: Ali ders çalışıyordu. O ___ ben televizyon izliyordum.
exercises.en: Ali was studying. Meanwhile, I was watching television.

reject.why: *O zaman* means **then** or **in that case**. **Meanwhile, at that very moment** is *o sırada*.

exercises.explain: *O sırada* + `-(I)yordu`: two scenes going on at the same time.

exercises.prompt: I got to the bus stop, but the bus had already left.
accept: Durağa vardım, ama otobüs çoktan kalkmıştı.
Durağa vardım, ama otobüs çoktan gitmişti.
Ben [durağa|otobüs durağına] vardım, ama otobüs çoktan [kalkmıştı|gitmişti].
Otobüs durağına vardım, ama otobüs çoktan [kalkmıştı|gitmişti].

reject.answer: Durağa vardım, ama otobüs çoktan kalktı.
reject.why: The bus left **before** you arrived, so the pluperfect: *kalkmıştı*.
